detail.title: Comfy Optical Wired Mouse
detail.overview: Discover the Comfy Optical Wired Mouse by Bestor, engineered for high performance, durability, and seamless connectivity.
features: Suitable for both left and right-handed users.
High precision on almost any surface.
Quick and easy USB plug-and-play setup.
Perfect for office, education, and basic gaming.
Compatible with PC, Mac, laptop, and Windows systems.
Ergonomic design for long hours of comfortable use.
Lightweight and portable with a 1.5-meter cable.
